title: Expressions with do and make
about: Phrasal verbs with do and make (do without, make up for, make out…) and their different meanings, plus the everyday collocations where English needs do or make, a classic trap when your own language has one verb for both.

parts.title: Phrasal verbs with do and make
Common mistakes
parts.note: Українське «робити» в англійській буває і do, і make. Орієнтир: do — дія, робота, обов'язок (do your homework, do the housework, do your best); make — коли з'являється результат: їжа, звук, рішення, гроші, план (make tea, make a noise, make a decision, make a profit). Правило працює не завжди, тому сталі вирази запам'ятовуй цілими. А деякі «зробити» — взагалі не do і не make: take a photo, take a break.

items.pattern: do without sth · can't do without sth · have to do without
items.meaning: manage without something you want or usually have
items.example: There's no milk left, so we'll have to **do without** it in our tea.
more: I couldn't **do without** my washing machine with three kids in the house.
If the shop's out of sugar, we'll just **do without**.

items.pattern: do away with sth (a rule, a fee, a tradition)
items.meaning: get rid of something, especially a rule or a system; abolish it
items.example: Many supermarkets have **done away with** plastic bags.
more: Our school **did away with** uniforms last year, and the kids love it.
I wish they'd **do away with** the extra fee for paying by card.
items.watchOut: Три слова, і частки не міняються: do away with. Не do out with і не do off with.

items.pattern: make for a place · (also) make for sth = help to create it
items.meaning: go towards a place; also: help to produce a result
items.example: When the fire alarm went off, everyone **made for** the stairs.
more: We parked the car and **made for** the beach.
Sunshine and a picnic in the park **make for** a perfect Sunday.
items.watchOut: Make for не означає «зробити для». We made for the station — ми рушили до вокзалу. «Зробити щось для когось» — make sth for sb: I made a cake for her.

items.pattern: What do you make of sb/sth? · not know what to make of sth
items.meaning: think about someone or something; form an opinion of it
items.uk: що ти думаєш про…; як це розуміти
items.example: What do you **make of** our new neighbours?
more: I didn't know what to **make of** her strange text message.
What did you **make of** the film? I didn't get the ending.
items.watchOut: Це питання про враження: What do you make of it? = What do you think of it? Не плутай із made of — «зроблений з»: The table is made of oak.

items.pattern: make off · make off with sth (= steal it and run away)
items.meaning: leave quickly, usually to escape
items.uk: втекти, дременути; make off with — поцупити й утекти
items.example: The kids rang our doorbell and **made off** down the street, laughing.
more: Someone **made off with** my bike while I was in the bakery.
The dog **made off with** a sausage from the barbecue.
items.watchOut: Утекти з украденим — make off with. Не make out with: в американській розмовній англійській це «цілуватися з кимось».

items.pattern: make up for sth (lost time, a mistake, bad weather) · make it up to sb
items.meaning: do or give something good so that something bad matters less; compensate for
items.example: The beautiful view **made up for** the long, tiring climb.
more: I'm working late tonight to **make up for** the time I lost this morning.
Sorry I forgot your birthday. Let me take you out to dinner to **make up for** it.
items.watchOut: У значенні «компенсувати» потрібне for: make up for the delay. Загладити провину перед кимось — make it up to sb: I'll make it up to you.

items.pattern: do up a coat / a zip / buttons / laces · do sth up · do it up
items.meaning: fasten clothes, buttons, a zip or shoelaces
items.example: **Do up** your coat. It's freezing outside.
more: Can you help me **do up** this zip at the back?
My little boy is still learning to **do up** his buttons.
items.watchOut: Застебнути — do up (або button up, zip up), не close. Протилежне — undo: undo your buttons. Займенник стоїть посередині: do it up, не do up it.

items.pattern: do up a house / a flat / a kitchen · do sth up · be done up
items.meaning: repair and decorate an old building or room so it looks new
items.example: They bought an old cottage and **did it up** themselves.
more: The café on the corner has been nicely **done up**.
We spent the whole summer **doing up** the kitchen.
items.watchOut: «Зробити ремонт у квартирі» — do up the flat, renovate або redecorate it. Калька make a repair in the flat звучить неприродно: repair — це полагодити щось зламане (repair the roof).

items.pattern: be done up in paper / with ribbon · done up in a bundle · do sth up
items.meaning: wrap something, or tie things together into a parcel or bundle
items.example: At the market, the fish was **done up** in newspaper.
more: The shop assistant **did up** the flowers with ribbon and tissue paper.
He **did up** the old newspapers in a bundle for recycling.

items.pattern: make out (that) … · make sb/sth out to be …
items.meaning: say that something is true, often when it isn't
items.example: He **made out** that he'd been ill, but we saw him at the football.
more: She **makes out** she's terribly busy, but she's always chatting on her phone.
The driving test wasn't as hard as everyone **made out**.
items.watchOut: У цьому значенні make out натякає, що людина, мабуть, каже неправду: He made out that he was ill — він удавав, ніби хворий.

items.pattern: can / can't / could just make out sth
items.meaning: manage to see, hear or read something with difficulty
items.example: It was so foggy that I could hardly **make out** the road signs.
more: I can't **make out** your handwriting. Is this a 3 or an 8?
Through the rain we could just **make out** the lights of the village.

items.pattern: can't make out why / what … · can't make sb out (usually with can't, couldn't, never)
items.meaning: understand someone's behaviour or why something is happening
items.example: I can't **make out** why she left so suddenly.
more: Nobody could **make out** what the boss wanted.
I couldn't **make out** whether she was joking or not.
items.watchOut: У значенні «зрозуміти» make out майже завжди з can't, couldn't або never. Займенник — посередині: I can't make him out.

items.pattern: make up a story / an excuse / a song · make sth up · make it up
items.meaning: invent a story or excuse that isn't true, or create a song or poem
items.example: Dad used to **make up** bedtime stories about a talking cat.
more: That's not true! You're **making it up**.
The kids **made up** a silly song about our dog.
items.watchOut: Займенник стоїть посередині: You're making it up, не making up it. Invent — частіше про винахід: invent a machine.

items.pattern: be made up of sth · sth makes up 60% of sth
items.meaning: consist of; (active) form part of a whole
items.example: Our book club **is made up of** six retired teachers.
more: Water **makes up** about 60% of the human body.
The village **is made up of** a church, a shop and a few farms.
items.watchOut: «Складатися з» — be made up of або consist of (без is!). Не is consisted of. У цьому значенні make up зазвичай у пасиві.

items.pattern: make yourself up · make up your eyes · be (heavily) made up · make-up (noun)
items.meaning: put cosmetics on your face
items.example: She was beautifully **made up** for her sister's wedding.
more: Actors are **made up** before they go on stage.
It takes me five minutes to **make myself up** in the morning.
items.watchOut: Дієслово — make up (два слова), іменник — make-up (через дефіс): She doesn't wear much make-up. У розмові частіше кажуть put on make-up.

items.pattern: make up a prescription / a medicine / a baby's bottle · make sth up
items.meaning: prepare medicine or food by mixing things together
items.example: The pharmacist **made up** my prescription in ten minutes.
more: Can you **make up** a bottle of milk for the baby?
The chemist **made up** a special cream for my rash.
items.watchOut: Лікар виписує рецепт (writes a prescription), а фармацевт за ним готує ліки — makes up a prescription. Аптека у Британії — the chemist's або pharmacy.

items.pattern: make up the numbers · make up the difference · make up a team
items.meaning: add people or things so that there are enough, or so that something is complete
items.example: We need one more player. Can you come and **make up the numbers**?
more: The bike costs £200. I've got £150. Can you **make up the difference**?
We invited a few neighbours to **make up the numbers** at the quiz night.

items.pattern: do your / my homework (uncountable: no a, no -s)
items.meaning: do the work a teacher gives you to do at home
items.example: You can watch TV after you've **done your homework**.
more: My daughter **does her homework** at the kitchen table.
Did you **do your homework** on the bus again?
items.watchOut: Домашнє завдання — do (це робота), не make. Homework незлічуване: do my homework, не a homework чи homeworks.

items.pattern: do the housework (uncountable)
items.meaning: do the cleaning, tidying and other jobs at home
items.example: I **do the housework** on Saturday mornings.
more: Nobody likes **doing the housework**, so we made a rota.
My husband and I take turns to **do the housework**.
items.watchOut: housework — хатня робота, homework — домашнє завдання. Обидва незлічувані й обидва з do: do the housework, не make the housework.

items.phrase: do the shopping / the cooking / the washing-up
items.pattern: do the + -ing for regular jobs (the ironing, the cleaning) · do some gardening
items.meaning: do the usual jobs of a home: buy food, cook, wash the dishes, work in the garden
items.uk: купувати продукти / готувати / мити посуд; попрацювати в саду
items.example: You cooked, so I'll **do the washing-up**.
more: Who **does the shopping** in your house?
On Sundays Dad likes to **do some gardening**.
items.watchOut: Регулярні хатні справи — do the + -ing: do the shopping, do the ironing. Не make the shopping і не wash the washing-up. Go shopping — пройтися по крамницях, часто для задоволення.

items.pattern: do (some / more) exercise · do exercises (particular movements) · also: take / get exercise
items.meaning: do physical activity to keep fit
items.example: My doctor says I should **do more exercise**.
more: I try to **do some exercise** every day, even if it's only a walk to the shops.
She **does exercises** for her bad back every morning.
items.watchOut: «Займатися спортом» — do exercise або do sport, не make sport. У значенні активності exercise незлічуване: do some exercise; exercises — окремі вправи.

items.pattern: do your / my / their best (to do sth)
items.meaning: try as hard as you can
items.example: I'll **do my best** to get there by six.
more: She **did her best**, but the cake still burnt.
The kids **did their best** to keep the flat tidy while we were away.
items.watchOut: Не make your best. Займенник відповідає підмету: I do my best, she does her best. Також можна try your best.

items.pattern: do business with sb · do business in a place
items.meaning: buy from, sell to or work together with a person or company
items.example: The bakery has **done business with** the same farm for twenty years.
more: I'd never **do business with** a company that ignores my emails.
We stopped **doing business with** that builder after he left the job half-finished.
items.watchOut: Не make business. «Мати справи з кимось» — do business with sb. А заробляти гроші — make money.

items.pattern: make (sb) a cup of tea / coffee · make breakfast / a cake / a sandwich
items.meaning: prepare a drink or some food
items.example: I'm going to **make a cup of tea**. Would you like one?
more: Mum **made** a chocolate cake for my birthday.
Who's going to **make breakfast** tomorrow?
items.watchOut: Їжа й напої — make: make tea, make dinner. Готувати як щоденний обов'язок — do the cooking.

items.pattern: make arrangements (for sth / to do sth), usually plural
items.meaning: plan and organise the details of something
items.example: We've **made arrangements** for Grandma to stay with us at Christmas.
more: Have you **made arrangements** for the cat while you're away?
I'll **make arrangements** to pick you up from the station.
items.watchOut: Зазвичай у множині: make arrangements. Не do arrangements. Простіше — arrange: I've arranged a taxi.

items.pattern: make an agreement (with sb) (to do sth) · also: reach / come to an agreement
items.meaning: agree with someone on what each of you will do
items.example: My brother and I **made an agreement**: I cook and he washes up.
more: The neighbours **made an agreement** to keep the noise down after ten.
We **made an agreement** with the landlord about the rent.
items.watchOut: Не do an agreement. Дійти згоди після суперечки — reach або come to an agreement.

items.pattern: make a suggestion (about sth) · suggest (that) …
items.meaning: offer an idea for others to think about
items.example: Can I **make a suggestion**? Let's eat outside tonight.
more: Nobody **made any suggestions**, so we went to the same pub as always.
That's a great idea. You should **make suggestions** more often.
items.watchOut: «Внести пропозицію» — make a suggestion, не do a suggestion. Після suggest не ставлять to + дієслово: I suggest going або I suggest (that) we go, не I suggest to go.

items.pattern: make a decision (about sth / to do sth) · UK also: take a decision
items.meaning: decide something
items.example: We need to **make a decision** about the holiday by Friday.
more: It was hard, but I think she **made the right decision**.
Never **make big decisions** when you're tired.
items.watchOut: «Прийняти рішення» — make a decision (у британській також take a decision). Accept a decision — погодитися з чужим рішенням, це інше.

items.pattern: make war (on sb) · make peace (with sb) · Make love, not war! (1960s slogan)
items.meaning: fight a war / stop fighting and agree to be friends again
items.example: After a year of not speaking, the two sisters finally **made peace**.
more: Our cat and the neighbour's dog have **made war** on each other for years.
It took the two families months to **make peace** after the argument about the fence.
items.watchOut: Make love — «кохатися», а не «любити» чи «закохатися» (fall in love). Помиритися після сварки — make peace або make up: They argued but made up the next day.

items.pattern: make an attempt to do sth / at sth · make no attempt to
items.meaning: try to do something, especially something difficult
items.example: I **made an attempt** to fix the tap myself, but I had to call a plumber.
more: He didn't **make any attempt** to help with the dishes.
She **made an attempt** at a soufflé, but it didn't rise.
items.watchOut: Не do an attempt. У розмові частіше просто try: I tried to fix it.

items.pattern: make a (phone) call (to sb) · take a call = answer one
items.meaning: phone someone
items.example: Excuse me, I need to **make a phone call**.
more: I **made three phone calls** before I found a plumber.
Can I use your phone to **make a quick call**?
items.watchOut: Зателефонувати — make a call, не do a call. Take a call — відповісти на дзвінок: Sorry, I have to take this call.

items.pattern: make the best of sth (a bad situation) · make the best of it
items.meaning: accept a difficult situation and make it as good as you can
items.uk: не падати духом і взяти з ситуації все можливе
items.example: The hotel was awful, but we **made the best of** it.
more: Our flat is tiny, but we **make the best of** the space we've got.
It rained all week, so we **made the best of** it and went to museums.
items.watchOut: Make the best of — про погану ситуацію; make the most of — використати сповна гарну можливість. У розмові їх іноді змішують, але різниця корисна.

items.pattern: make an effort (to do sth) · make a real / big effort · make no effort
items.meaning: try hard; use energy to do something
items.example: Please **make an effort** to be on time tomorrow.
more: He really **made an effort** with dinner tonight. It was delicious.
I **make an effort** to call my grandparents every week.
items.watchOut: Не do an effort. Також: put effort into sth — вкладати зусилля в щось.

items.pattern: make an excuse (for sth) · make excuses
items.meaning: give a reason, often an untrue one, for not doing something
items.example: He always **makes an excuse** when it's his turn to clean the bathroom.
more: Stop **making excuses** and start revising!
I **made an excuse** and left the party early.
items.watchOut: Не say / tell an excuse. Вимова: іменник excuse — /ɪkˈskjuːs/ зі звуком [s], дієслово excuse (Excuse me) — /ɪkˈskjuːz/ зі звуком [z].

items.pattern: make a mistake · make mistakes · by mistake
items.meaning: do something wrong without meaning to
items.example: I **made a mistake** with the address and went to the wrong house.
more: Everyone **makes mistakes** when they're learning to drive.
Sorry, I think you've **made a mistake** on the bill.
items.watchOut: Помилку «роблять» з make: make a mistake, не do a mistake. Помилково, випадково — by mistake.

items.pattern: make a profit / a loss (on sth) · make money
items.meaning: earn more money than you spend / lose money
items.example: The new café **made a profit** in its first year.
more: We **made a loss** when we sold our old car.
The school fair **made a profit** of £800 for the library.
items.watchOut: Прибуток, збиток і гроші — з make: make a profit, make money. Не do money, не do a profit.

items.pattern: make the most of sth (time, a chance, good weather)
items.meaning: use a good situation as fully as you can
items.example: It's sunny today, so let's **make the most of** it and go to the beach.
more: **Make the most of** your free time before the baby arrives.
We only had two days in Rome, but we **made the most of** them.
items.watchOut: «Використати сповна» — make the most of, не use the maximum of. Порівняй: make the best of — про погану ситуацію.

items.pattern: make a noise · make (a lot of) noise
items.meaning: produce a sound, often a loud or unpleasant one
items.example: Please don't **make a noise**. The baby's asleep.
more: The fridge is **making a strange noise** again.
The neighbours' kids **make a lot of noise** after school.
items.watchOut: Шуміти — make a noise, не do a noise.

items.pattern: make a good / bad / great impression (on sb) · first impression
items.meaning: make people think well or badly of you
items.example: He cooked dinner for her parents to **make a good impression**.
more: Arriving late doesn't **make a good impression**.
The hotel **made a great impression** on us from the moment we arrived.
items.watchOut: «Справити враження на когось» — make an impression on sb, не do an impression. Do an impression of sb — це «пародіювати когось»: He does a great impression of our teacher.

items.phrase: make a success of / make a go of
items.pattern: make a success of sth · make a go of sth (informal)
items.meaning: make something work well and succeed
items.example: She opened a small bakery and **made a success of** it.
more: They moved to the countryside to **make a go of** farming.
We're determined to **make a go of** this new shop.
items.watchOut: Make a go of sth — домогтися успіху, а have a go (at sth) — спробувати: Can I have a go? Не плутай ці два вирази.

items.pattern: make allowances for sb / sth (age, illness, the fact that …)
items.meaning: judge someone less strictly because of their situation
items.uk: зважати на (вік, обставини), не судити суворо
items.example: You should **make allowances for** him. It's only his first week in the job.
more: Grandma is ninety, so we **make allowances for** her forgetfulness.
The teacher **made allowances for** Sam because he'd been ill.
items.watchOut: Allowances тут завжди у множині: make allowances for sb's age. Allowance окремо — ще й «кишенькові гроші, допомога».

items.pattern: make a gesture (to sb / for sb to do sth) · a gesture of thanks
items.meaning: move your hand or head to show something; also: do something small to show your feelings
items.example: She **made a gesture** for me to sit down.
more: He **made a rude gesture** at the other driver and drove off.
The shop **made a kind gesture** and gave us free delivery.
items.watchOut: Вимова: gesture починається зі звуку [дж] — /ˈdʒestʃə/, а не [г].

items.pattern: make a face (at sb) · make faces · UK also: pull a face
items.meaning: twist your face to show you don't like something, or to be funny
items.example: My son **made a face** when he saw the broccoli.
more: The kids were **making faces** at each other behind the teacher's back.
She tasted the soup and **made a face**.
items.watchOut: Скривитися — make a face (брит. також pull a face). Не do a face.

items.pattern: make fun of sb / sth
items.meaning: laugh at someone or something in an unkind way
items.example: The other kids **made fun of** his old trainers.
more: Stop **making fun of** your sister's haircut!
I don't mind people **making fun of** my accent.
items.watchOut: Глузувати з когось — make fun of sb, без артикля і саме з of (не from, не with). Have fun — розважатися, це про інше.

items.pattern: make a fuss of sb (UK) · make a fuss about sth (= complain)
items.meaning: give someone a lot of attention and treat them well
items.example: My grandparents always **make a fuss of** us when we visit.
more: The dog loves it when guests **make a fuss of** him.
Everyone **made a fuss of** her on her birthday.
items.watchOut: Прийменник змінює зміст: make a fuss of sb — оточити увагою (приємно), make a fuss about sth — здіймати галас через дрібницю.

warmup.q: I ___ a mistake in the address.
warmup.explain: Помилку «роблять» з make: make a mistake. Do a mistake — калька.

warmup.q: The kids ___ their homework in the kitchen.
warmup.explain: Домашнє завдання — do your homework. «Вчити уроки» — теж do homework, не learn.

warmup.uk: Нам треба прийняти рішення до п'ятниці.
warmup.q: We need to ___ a decision by Friday.
warmup.explain: Прийняти рішення — make a decision (у британській також take). Accept a decision — погодитися з чужим рішенням.

warmup.uk: Він хотів справити гарне враження на її батьків.
warmup.q: He wanted to ___ a good impression on her parents.
warmup.explain: Справити враження — make an impression on sb. Do an impression — пародіювати когось.

warmup.uk: Сьогодні сонячно, тож використаймо цей день сповна.
warmup.q: It's sunny today, so let's make ___ of it.
warmup.explain: Використати сповна — make the most of. The maximum тут не вживають.

warmup.uk: Що ти думаєш про нашого нового сусіда?
warmup.q: What do you ___ our new neighbour?
warmup.explain: What do you make of…? — питання про враження. Можна й What do you think of…?, але не make about.

warmup.q: The sunny Sunday ___ the rainy Saturday.
warmup.explain: Компенсувати — make up for sth. Made out — розгледів або удавав; did away with — скасував.

warmup.uk: Наша команда складається з шести людей.
warmup.explain: Складатися з — be made up of або consist of (без is). Is consisted of — типова помилка.

A.q: The car's at the garage, so we'll have to ___ it for a week.
A.explain: Do without — обійтися без. Do away with — скасувати, позбутися; make off with — поцупити й утекти.

A.q: The baby was tired, so we ___ home straight after lunch.
A.explain: Make for — рушити до якогось місця. Made to тут неможливе, made of — «зроблений з».

A.q: He brought me flowers to ___ being late.
A.explain: Make up for — компенсувати. Make for — прямувати кудись; make off with — поцупити й утекти.

B.q: We're ___ our flat before the baby arrives.
B.explain: Do up — відремонтувати й оновити житло. Make up — вигадати, скласти; make out — розгледіти.

B.q: I can't ___ what the sign says. It's too far away.
B.explain: Make out — розгледіти, розібрати (зазвичай із can / can't). Make up — вигадати; make of — думати про.
Make it up — вигадувати. Займенник стоїть між make і up.

C.q: I'll ___ the housework while you're at the shops.

example.title: The house by the river
example.uk:
Два роки тому моя сестра з чоловіком купили старий будинок біля річки й вирішили відремонтувати його самі. Кілька місяців вони обходилися без нормальної кухні й готували на туристичній плитці.

Спочатку вони наробили багато помилок, але ніколи не здавалися. Вони старалися закінчувати одну кімнату щомісяця, і нікому не дозволялося сміятися з кривих полиць.

Минулих вихідних я нарешті поїхав до них, і вся родина носилася зі мною. Сестра заварила чай, і ми сіли на новій кухні. «Ну, і як тобі?» — запитала вона. Чесно кажучи, сам лише краєвид компенсував довгу дорогу. У них справді все вийшло.
example.en:
Two years ago my sister and her husband bought an old house by the river and decided to [[do it up|b2]] themselves. For months they [[did without|a1]] a proper kitchen and cooked on a camping stove.

They [[made a lot of mistakes|c18]] at first, but they never gave up. They [[made an effort|c16]] to finish one room every month, and nobody was allowed to [[make fun of|c27]] the crooked shelves.

Last weekend I finally visited, and the whole family [[made a fuss of|c28]] me. My sister [[made a cup of tea|c7]], and we sat in the new kitchen. 'So, what do you [[make of|a4]] it?' she asked. Honestly, the view alone [[made up for|a6]] the long drive. They've really [[made a success of|c23]] it.
